This member of the [[Tonith family]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who served as [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. He was succeeded by fellow Muun [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]]. As chairman, Tonith worked with [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], who, unbeknownst to Tonith, was the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as Darth Plagueis. Before that, Tonith had worked with Damask's father, [[Caar Damask|Caar]].
